insights: The design system uses a strong contrast between light (#EAE9E7) and dark (#00050A 'ghost-void') sections with the brand orange (#FF5517) as the primary accent color and blue (#006DDF) for interactive elements.
Motion design relies heavily on soft-focus blur transitions and scroll-triggered reveals, creating a premium tech aesthetic with subtle parallax and scanline effects.
Button styles are consistently sharp-cornered (rounded-none) across all variants, maintaining a modern industrial aesthetic that matches the hardware product being showcased.
